text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 24, 2024) for 5 Elm Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 24, 2024) for 5 Elm Avenue, Folder Number 24 215626 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to March 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
